cases.name: flag operator|
cases.note: The Rust-language port uses a faithful test-only std::mt19937_64 fixture seeded with 0xf934929 and typed Rust flag wrappers to compare enum operations with their integral oracle.

adaptation.inapplicable_observable: C++ enum-class detection, overloaded-operator syntax, and underlying-type template identity
adaptation.rationale: Typed Rust flag wrappers preserve the enum-versus-integral oracle, the pinned std::mt19937_64 sample stream, and every runtime-observable value check, including the pinned Flags64 accidental decr call.
